about.en: PUSS (PussFi) is a cat-themed memecoin on TRON, launched through the SunPump platform and promoted as the first memecoin of the Steemit community. It is the TRC-20 token at TX5eXdf8458bZ77fk8xdvUgiQmC3L93iv7; it carries no claim on any issuer, and unrelated tokens such as PussyCat also use the PUSS ticker.
